toTrashTip: Stays in the trash for {days} days and can be restored. Without the switch it is gone at once.
toTrashTipSystem: Goes to the {bin} and can be restored. Without the switch it is gone at once.
whereTrash: {size}, goes into the trash and can be restored for {days} days
whereSystem: {size}, goes to the {bin} and can be restored
title: Trash
emptyText: What you delete stays here for {days} days before it is gone for good.
emptyTextSystem: What you delete goes to the {bin}. You can bring it back here just as in any other file manager.
nextTip: Everything in the trash is removed for good {days} days after it was deleted. Set the time under Settings, Files.
whereTip: In the desktop app CannonCommander uses the trash of the system. The system decides how long it keeps things.
byTip: Deleted by {by}, gone for good on {date}

emptySystem.one: This empties the whole {bin} with its one entry.
emptySystem.other: This empties the whole {bin}: all {n} entries, those from other programs too.

gone: Afterwards it is gone and cannot be restored.
noBinText: {what} is on a drive without a trash, such as a network drive. Would you like to delete it for good instead? It cannot be restored afterwards.
